row:
We run Zoom CPD tutorials fortnightly at 8am Mondays AEST. 

These are casual, case-based and well suited to people with an interest in small animal internal medicine.  Please join the CPD Tutorial Group by subscribing on our website.

https://vetsnorth.com.au/tutorial-schedule
